message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crime based on facts: selling health product containing sildenafil (a prescription drug) without license. In China, illegal sale of prescription drugs is "非法经营罪" (illegal business) or "非法生产、销售假药罪"? Since product is not approved, contains prescription drug, could be "非法经营药品罪" under Criminal Law article 141? Actually Article 141: "非法经营罪" includes illegal sale of medical devices, medicines without license. Also "生产、销售假药罪" if product is counterfeit or adulterated. Here it's a health product containing sildenafil, not approved as health food, so it's "非法经营药品罪" (illegal business of medicines). Could also be "非法销售有毒、有害食品罪"? But it's a drug, not food. So answer: [罪名]非法经营罪<eoa>
